nodes.name: Record Send Ids
nodes.notes: Zips the Resend batch response ids (in request order) with the recipients from the matching "Build Resend Batches" chunk, using itemMatching() (n8n's pairedItem linkage) rather than raw array/batch_index position -- see in-code comment for why. Emits {resend_email_id, campaign_id, email, subject} rows for "Save Send Ids" to upsert. Never throws: unmapped or mismatched chunks are silently skipped so attribution failures can't block the send.

nodes.name: Save Send Ids
nodes.notes: Upserts resend_email_id -> campaign_id/email/subject into campaign_sends (PK = resend_email_id; Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates makes the POST an upsert). executeOnce=true + $input.all() bulk-inserts every row from "Record Send Ids" in one request instead of one call per recipient. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData=true so a failed or empty attribution write can never stop "Mark Complete" from running. Authenticates with the existing "Sproutify Trellis" Supabase credential via Predefined Credential Type (supabaseApi), which injects apikey + Authorization: Bearer automatically - no key pasted into this workflow.

parameters.content:
## Trellis: Campaign Dispatch Gateway (Resend Batch)

**What changed:** Trellis now sends the **exact segment audience** it built (already deduped by email, consent-filtered, narrowed to the selected segments/branches) plus a personalizable HTML template. This workflow chunks that audience into groups of **100** and sends each via Resend's **`/emails/batch`** endpoint — one HTTP call per 100 recipients instead of one per person.

**Webhook URL:** `https://n8n.sproutify.app/webhook/trellis-campaign-dispatch`

**Expected POST body (from Trellis CampaignBuilder):**
```json
{
  "campaign_id": "uuid",
  "subject": "Spring Sale!",
  "from": "ATL Urban Farms <sheree@atlurbanfarms.com>",
  "html_template": "<html>... {{first_name}} ... {{unsubscribe_url}} ...</html>",
  "recipients": [ { "email": "a@x.com", "first_name": "Ada" }, ... ],
  "recipient_count": 1234
}
```

### FLOW
Webhook → **Build Resend Batches** (Code: personalize `{{first_name}}` / `{{unsubscribe_url}}` per recipient, chunk into <=100) → **Resend Batch Dispatch** (`POST /emails/batch`, runs once per chunk) → **Record Send Ids** (Code: zips the batch response ids with the chunk's recipients — see CAMPAIGN ATTRIBUTION below) → **Save Send Ids** (upserts the mapping into Hub `campaign_sends`) → **Mark Complete** (PATCH Hub `campaigns` → completed).

### CAMPAIGN ATTRIBUTION (new)
`email_events.campaign_id` used to be populated by NOTHING — Reports matched campaigns by comparing `campaign_subject` strings, so two campaigns sharing a subject line silently merged in the stats. Resend's `/emails/batch` endpoint accepts **no per-message tags or metadata**, so the campaign id can't ride along with the send request itself.

Instead: `/emails/batch` returns `{ "data": [ { "id": "..." }, ... ] }` **in the same order as the request array**. **Record Send Ids** zips those returned ids with the recipients from the matching `Build Resend Batches` chunk (paired via n8n's `itemMatching()`, not raw array position — see the node's own comments) and **Save Send Ids** upserts `{ resend_email_id, campaign_id, email, subject }` rows into Hub `campaign_sends` (`Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates`, PK = `resend_email_id`). The `resend-webhook` edge function then looks up `campaign_sends` by `data.email_id` on every inbound event and stamps `email_events.campaign_id` before insert — exact per-campaign attribution instead of subject-string guessing.

Both new nodes are wired with `onError: continueRegularOutput` + `alwaysOutputData: true`: if the attribution write fails or a chunk can't be mapped, the campaign send itself is untouched and `Mark Complete` still fires.

**Prerequisite SQL** (already applied on the live Hub `horvjqqifgrzxesuxtfm`; mirrored in `constants.ts` SQL_SCHEMA for the record):
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_sends (
  resend_email_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  campaign_id UUID,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
-- + indexes on campaign_id/email, RLS enabled, service_role ALL policy,
-- anon/authenticated SELECT policy + grants (mirrors email_events)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW campaign_stats_by_id WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT campaign_id, ... FROM email_events WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY campaign_id;
```

### SETUP REQUIRED
**Resend Batch Dispatch node:**
- Replace `YOUR_RESEND_API_KEY` with your Resend token (`re_...`). Prefer a **Header Auth credential** over pasting the key.
- Batching is set to 1 request / 600ms to stay under Resend's default 2 req/s. Raise the interval if you see **429**s, or lower it if your plan allows more.

**Save Send Ids node:**
- Replace the Sproutify Trellis Supabase credential (both headers) with the Hub Supabase service_role key — same convention as **Mark Complete** below.

**Mark Complete node:**
- Uses the existing **Sproutify Trellis** Supabase credential (`supabaseApi`) via *Predefined Credential Type* - no key to paste. If `supabaseApi` is missing from the HTTP Request node's credential dropdown on your n8n version, fall back to a **Header Auth** credential supplying `apikey` + `Authorization: Bearer <service_role>`. Skip/disable this node if you only track campaigns in localStorage.

### NOTES
- **No audience RPC anymore.** The old `resolve_newsletter_audience` shortcut (blasted ALL active ATL subscribers, ignoring your segments) is gone — the audience is now whatever Trellis targeted. If you ever want a server-resolved fallback, add a branch that calls a Hub audience RPC when `recipients` is empty.
- **Batch limits:** `/emails/batch` accepts up to 100 messages/call and does not support per-message `attachments`, `tags`, `metadata`, or `scheduled_at` — that's exactly why campaign attribution is done out-of-band via the id-mapping chain above (`Record Send Ids` → `Save Send Ids` → `campaign_sends`) instead of tagging each message.
- **Empty audience:** if `recipients` is empty, the Code node emits nothing and no email is sent (campaign is not marked complete).
